title: Icon dive into a tilted dashboard tour
summary: A three-line offer rises over a dark backdrop with a blue rim, an app-icon tile drops in and the camera dives through it, then seven light UI screens glide past on tilted planes under blue light for 30 s, each one held about 4 s.
use_when: A business or back-office product with many dense screens and no single hero moment
A silent premium showcase for a site header, sales deck or social feed
You have 5-7 clean screens and want each one readable for about 4 s
The offer (demo, trial) should open the film instead of closing it

look.type_style: opening offer: condensed bold sans, title case, tight, 3 centred lines ~6.5 % H each; UI: small tracked uppercase labels and bold italic screen titles

sfx.event: offer block slides up from below the frame
camera dives through the app-icon tile
light sheen passes across a tilted screen

structure.shot: black backdrop with a thin blue rim lower left; offer statement, 3 lines of 3-4 words, centred
structure.camera: drift 1.00->1.06 over 1.00-2.00 s (5.9 %/s), then near hold (1.6 %/s)
structure.motion: block slides up from below the frame 0.27-0.77 s, easings.outExpo ~15 fr (±0.25 s); holds 2.2 s; exits downward 3.00-3.27 s, easings.inExpo ~8 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: rounded app-icon tile with the mark and wordmark drops in from the top, then fills the frame
structure.camera: zoom-through: tile ~0.16 W at 3.50 s to larger than the frame at 4.00 s (~118 %/s)
structure.motion: tile enters from above 3.27-3.50 s, springs.ui ~7 fr (overshoot not measurable); scale-up easings.inExpo ~15 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: screen 1: light dashboard with sidebar and KPI cards on a plane leaned back, right half of frame, far edge falls off in blur
structure.motion: plane already in place on the cut; constant glide easings.linear; no UI animation

structure.shot: same screen; a blue light streak sweeps in along the top edge of the frame
structure.camera: dolly left 78 px/s until 8.00 s, then push-in 6 %/s
structure.motion: light streak grows from the top right over ~1 s, easings.inOutSine (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: same screen held; the blue light widens into a broad glow at top
screen 2: data table with search field and status chips, plane steeply tilted, header top left
structure.camera: push-in ~6 %/s, pan up 40 px/s (1.3 px/fr), roll -1 to -2 deg/s
structure.motion: on 11.47-12.00 the plane slides left 276 px/s then settles, springs.heavy (overshoot not measurable); white sheen passes 14.00-14.50 s

structure.shot: screen 3: close-up of a form dialog (title, message field, picker, two buttons) over a tilted panel; blue light bands behind
structure.camera: drift right 41 px/s and up 20 px/s, roll ~2 deg/s, scale +-2 %/s
structure.motion: no UI animation; slow drift easings.linear

structure.shot: screen 4: wide inventory table nearly face-on, slight lean, blue glow shapes behind
structure.motion: no UI animation; diagonal reflection band sits across the plate

structure.shot: same table; background light changes to a diagonal blue band under the plate
structure.motion: background band slides across, easings.linear (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: screen 5: KPI card grid on a plane rotated about 40 deg, running diagonally top left to bottom right, header top
structure.camera: drift right 13-30 px/s and down 18 px/s, scale +-1 %/s

structure.shot: screen 6: wide matrix table with coloured status pills, plane leaned back low in frame
structure.camera: pull-out -2.3 to -3.1 %/s, pan right 33 px/s (1.1 px/fr)

structure.shot: screen 7: breakdown card with rows, totals and blue progress bars on a thick rounded slab, tilted
structure.camera: push-in 1.7 %/s, pan left 22 px/s, roll -2 to -3 deg/s
structure.motion: slab glides and turns, easings.linear; no UI animation

structure.shot: same slab; a blue rim of light appears behind its top right corner
structure.motion: rim fades up over ~0.5 s, easings.inOutSine (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: black backdrop with the blue rim only, as in the opening

params.offer: opening statement, 3 lines of 3-4 words: the outcome plus how to get a demo
params.icon: square app-icon tile: mark + wordmark on a light rounded plate
params.screens: 5-7 light UI screens (rebuilt or screenshots), each with its plane angle and camera move
params.timing.hold: seconds per screen (reference 3.3-4.7 s, about 4 s)
params.light: accent blue for the rim, streaks and glow behind the planes

notes: Silent reference, 8 hard cuts + 1 soft (zoom-through 3.43-3.93 s). Every screen is a light plate on black under a heavy vignette; the far edge of each plane falls into blur (depth of field). Camera speeds are slow and constant (1-3 px/fr, 1-6 %/s); no UI element animates, the camera and light carry all motion. Beat labels follow the first-match rule: the mark comes at 3.43 s, so every screen row after it reads outro; functionally rows 3-13 are the feature tour. Proposed term plane-sheen (light band sweeping across a tilted screen, rows 4, 6, 8) is not in the vocabulary. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured.
